title: Fine-tuning an LLM to write docs like it's 1995
summary: An experimental project where the author fine-tunes a large language model to generate technical documentation in the classic 1995 style - characterized by brevity, directness, and no-nonsense technical writing, rather than the verbose AI-generated content common today.
problem_solved: Addresses the problem of modern AI-generated documentation being overly verbose, templated, and lacking the concise, authoritative style of classic technical writing.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how fine-tuning can teach AI models specific stylistic preferences, showing that AI output style is customizable beyond just prompting.
